notes: Reviewed openspec's 7 ACs — all were solid and observable. Modifications: AC7 reworded to replace vague 'same format and location' with specific 'same currency format and same relative position within each line item section' to make it testable. Additions: 5 new ACs covering (1) fractional currency decimal precision, (2) negative or unexpectedly large discount values rendered faithfully from the order payload, (3) text-only email client rendering, (4) promo code applying only to outbound with no return discount in the payload — a distinct edge case from AC5 (no promo at all) and AC6 (zero discount). Flagged AC7 original for vagueness.
